subject: english
title: Unit 9 Grammar 2 App — Definitions with which
subtitle: Leo rebuilds the Lab Dictionary across 12 modules: the who/which gate, the fusion chamber, the ghost hunt, build-a-definition, and his own dictionary entry.

content: Write and say definitions of things independently using the frame noun + which + verb phrase.
Fuse two short sentences into one definition and delete the echoing pronoun the clause replaced.
Choose between who and which by deciding whether the noun is a person or a thing.
language: Produce definitions with which for gravity, friction, a bicycle, a whistle, a dictionary, and tetherball.
Use that as a substitute for which, and recognise the person trap where only who works.
Write one original dictionary definition using which, and complete the review quiz.
